name: Dark Recall
source:
In the year 2076 as mankind's resources dwindled, they began desperately reaching out to the stars in order to find a new home.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161209142949/http://www.terabit-software.co.uk/DarkRecall.aspx]official website[/url]]
translation:
2076年，人類的資源日益枯竭。為了尋找新的家園，人類開始絕望地向群星發出求救。

［來自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161209142949/http://www.terabit-software.co.uk/DarkRecall.aspx]官方網站[/url]］
